titles.romaji: Itsuka Tenma no Kuro Usagi OVA
titles.english: A Dark Rabbit has Seven Lives OVA
titles.native: いつか天魔の黒ウサギ OVA

description:
According to the official website, an OVA of Itsuka Tenma no Kuro Usagi was announced to be bundled with the ninth volume of the novel.

An animated crossover between Itsu-Ten and The Legend of the Legendary Heroes (Densetsu no Yuusha no Densetsu or DenYuuDen) fantasy story.
